description:
Check history of one monitor, newest first: one row per check per region with status, response time, HTTP status, error type and message.

Paginate with "before" = next_before from the previous page. status "problem" returns every non-up check. Returns {items:[{id, checked_at, region, status, response_time_ms, status_code, error_type, error_message}], next_before}.

before.description: ISO-8601 cursor: only checks before this time (next_before of the previous page)

monitor_id.description: Monitor id (UUID). Use sutramx_list_monitors to find it.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (readable summary) or 'json' (full structured data)

name: sutramx_get_check_results
title: Get check results
